[[Yunist Stadium (Chernihiv)|Yunist Stadium]], [[Chernihiv]] {{small|(2021)}} | capacity = 3,000{{cite web|url=http://stadiums.at.ua/news/2013-04-20-12350|script-title=uk:Стадион донецкого Олимпика после реконструкции (Фото)|trans-title=Stadium Olimpik Donetsk after reconstruction (Photo)|date=20 April 2014|access-date=31 May 2014|work=stadiums.at.ua|language=uk|archive-date=6 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201106182759/http://stadiums.at.ua/news/2013-04-20-12350|url-status=live}} | clubname = Olimpik Donetsk | image = FC Olimpik Donetsk logo.svg | fullname = FC Olimpik Donetsk | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|2001}} | dissolved = 2022 | owntitle = President | owner = Andriy Horeltsev | manager = | league = | position = Ukrainian First League, 11th of 16 | season = [[2021–22 Ukrainian First League|2021–22]] | current = | website = {{URL|https://olimpik.com.ua/}} | pattern_la1 = _ghazlelmahalla2021h | pattern_b1 = _ghazlelmahalla2021h | pattern_ra1 = _ghazlelmahalla2021h | pattern_sh1 = _fcminaj2122h | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _ornament2021a | pattern_b2 = _ornament2021a | pattern_ra2 = _ornament2021a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 }} [[File:Olimpik Donetsk.jpg|thumb|Old emblem (2001–2019)]] '''FC Olimpik Donetsk''' ({{langx|uk|«Олімпік» Донецьк}} {{IPA|uk|oˈl⁽ʲ⁾impiɡ doˈnɛtsʲk|}}) is a Ukrainian inactive football team based in [[Donetsk]], Ukraine. The club currently doesn't play in any Ukrainian competition due to the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. Since its promotion to [[Ukrainian Premier League]] in 2014, it played its games in [[Kyiv]] due to the [[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|war in Donbas]]. During the [[2016–17 Ukrainian Premier League]], there were attempts to move the club either to [[Sumy]] or [[Cherkasy]], which were never realized. On 21 June 2023 the 31st PFL Conference excluded several clubs that did not compete in the 2022–23 season and did not renew their membership.[https://web.archive.org/web/20230624005207/http://pfl.ua/news/details/13469 ХХХІ чергова Конференція ПФЛ: підсумували сезон 2022/23, визначили орієнтири нового чемпіонату]. pfl.ua. 21 June 2023"}}
